allocation.order: Root, frozen team order, common seed order
allocation.withinRoot: One 256-value common panel for all nine teams
allocation.acrossRoots: Twelve disjoint panels, excluded from complete live history; identical recipes in different roots are not deduplicated
allocation.samplingRandomness: Population-sampling bytes are not combat seeds and must not be reused as combat entropy

reporting.intervalFamily: 108 recipe rates plus 432 gain/loss rates for 216 signed paired comparisons; reuse established approximate family-adjusted Wilson arithmetic
reporting.benchmark: The fixed strongest reference 96b94357, not the panel-wise best reference
reporting.strata: Report nominees, near misses and sampled lower candidates separately, for every root
reporting.lowerPopulationMean: The mean of the two sampled gains estimates the finite 13-candidate stratum mean; use inclusion weight 13/2 for totals
reporting.fullCandidateMean: For each frozen root: (sum of four measured nominee/near-miss gains + (13/2)*sum of two sampled lower gains)/17
reporting.limitations: Lower-stratum sampling and combat uncertainty are separate. No unsampled outcome imputation, raw-pool unweighted average, post-hoc best-team adoption or future-root reliability claim.

requiredBeforeExecution: A separately versioned native/audit profile for this affinity-creation plan and captured runtime; the existing recognition profile pins the earlier adaptive-cohort plan and must continue rejecting this one
Captured-runtime compatibility, complete live reservation history and a fresh admitted request
Explicit cumulative elapsed-time/storage envelope covering admission, owned execution, both audits and publication
One post-freeze combat entropy batch, permanent reservation of every exposed fresh value, no retries or replacement roots
Native reconstruction and independent saved-battle audit of all 27,648 attempts and every reported stratum
